If you have any questions or comments, please contact:  
SAUDIA Manager in your area  
 
 
Saudia has updated Irregular Operation and Disruption Bulletins as per the instructions provided below:  
 
Irregular Operation and Disruption 
“Flight disruption” is defined as “situations where a scheduled flight is cancelled, or delayed for two hours or more, 
within 48 hours of the original scheduled departure time”.  
o SAUDIA must inform the guest of all available alternatives and options, as well as explain all of their rights 
to compensation. 
▪ This policy applies to all passengers who have completed travel procedures and/or the arrival time 
specified by SAUDIA in accordance with the general terms & conditions of transport and tariffs 
described. 
▪ Planned changes means all flights disruptions made outside of the operational window, while 
Unplanned changes means flights disruptions that happen within the operational window and at the 
airports. 
▪ Involuntary changes are only permitted on the affected end -to-end route/segments of that ticket and 
does not include any other tickets made separately by the guests. The remaining unaffected 
route/segments on the ticket should be handled as voluntary change if the guest requests it. However, 
some cases might be considered for changing the unaffected route/segments according to guest’s 
travel plans with a pre-approval request via Saudia manager in your area. 
▪ It’s permitted to change the guest return/connecting flight if the delay affects the MCT or if the return 
flight is booked on the same day (24 hours). All affected MCTs, however, can be changed, processed, 
and adjusted as appropriate. 
o The mentioned below regulations are set out for all flights departing from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and 
all flights arriving to KSA unless the passenger is compensated according to the regulations of the country 
of departure, such as EU, UK, US & DOT regulations, etc...  
o It is permitted to look for volunteer travelers in accordance with the rules outlined in this manual. 
o Through the SAUDIA website/App, the guest can accept, reject, or modify the reservation, and that 
decision will be reflected in the reservation record assigned  by Saudia. This modification is considered as 
the guest's acceptance of the alternative presented. 
▪ If the guest declines it, SAUDIA should look for other options.  
▪ If the guest accepts it, any subsequent changes will be considered voluntary, and fees may apply 
according to fare rules. 
▪ If the alternative is provided within 2 hours of the departure time, SAUDIA is exempt from any 
compensation for disruptions caused by SV due to operational reasons. Otherwise, alternatives 
exceeding two hours must be handled in accordance with the flight delays article mentioned in this 
procedure. 
o If the guest is notified of the flight status, the guest will have five days to respond with acceptance or 
rejection. Failure to respond is subsequently taken as the guest's implicit acceptance.  
o If a PNR confirmation is needed, a request must be sent to  Saudia manager in your area to confirm the 
same class of booking. In case there was no response from Saudia, it is permitted to proceed with 
involuntary ticket changes as described in the ticketing manual. 
o In the event of other cases, inquiries, or authority needed, a request can be submitted to the seek authority 
from Saudia manger in your area , taking into account the ticket validity date, and attaching all documents 
and special documents to support the request. 
o Saudia manager in your area is entitled to whatever they deem appropriate and in the interest of Saudia for 
all cases. 
Irregular Operation and Disruption 
Reference: 202311202 Effective Date: 20 Nov 2023

Some exciting news to share: Saudia is launching a new nonstop service between Riyadh (RUH) and Tokyo Narita (NRT) from 17 November 2026. The route is now open for sales, and we would very much welcome your support in bringing it to market.
This will be the only nonstop link between Saudi Arabia and Japan. Schedule details:
Frequency: 3x weekly — Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays
Aircraft: Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner
SV824 RUH 01:00 → NRT 17:25  (approx. 10h25)

Featured route/destination placements leading to the 17 Nov launch
A “Discover Saudi” inbound push positioning the Kingdom to your Japan audience
Co-branded creative and content built around the new connection
Can we grab a short call in the next few days to kick ideas around and agree next steps?
Feel free to reach me directly (email or WhatsApp) with a couple of times that work for you, and I'll fit around your schedule.
Looking forward to getting this off the ground together.

Adam
